name: Christine Chacon Kennedy
office: East Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Christine Chacon Kennedy was appointed to the East Whittier City School District board in 2003 and elected in 2005. She holds an associate degree from Cerritos College. In a 2026 news questionnaire, she said her priorities include modernizing the Emma Wicker auditorium and ensuring safe, secure, and accessible schools.
